page.tested_text: We read the project's own page: **10,000 stars**, MIT licence, **eleven skills**, no sign-up and no API key. It says plainly what to expect: it rebuilds **what an app does, never what it owns**, and **a booking tool takes weeks**, not minutes. The numbers in the reel (18 screens, a score of 86, 140 reviews) come from the project's own worked example. **Not checked by us:** building a full app with it.
page.tip: **The tip:** run /replica-entrepreneur first, on its own. It reads the real reviews and tells you whether the app is worth rebuilding before you spend a weekend on it.

followups.label: No Claude Code? Try this first
followups.prompt: I pay for [app name] but I only use it for three things: [thing 1], [thing 2], [thing 3]. Build me my own simple tool that does just those three things, as a single page I can use right here. Give it a new name and its own look. Don't copy the original's name, logo or wording.
followups.note: This is our own prompt. It works in any Claude chat and is best for small tools: trackers, calculators, planners, simple forms.

followups.label: Study the app, then see what its users hate
followups.note: The first maps the screens and features. The second reads real reviews and lists the top complaints, each with a link.

followups.label: Build it, then score it
followups.note: Builds your version screen by screen, then scores it against the original and lists what's missing.

checklist_title: Set it up in five steps

checklist.title: Have Claude Code
checklist.detail: The claude command in a terminal (or the Code tab in the Claude desktop app), on a paid Claude plan. The tools also need Python 3.8 or newer.

checklist.title: Paste the link and say install skill
checklist.detail: Paste the two lines above. Claude downloads the eleven skills.

checklist.title: Start small
checklist.detail: Pick a simple app you really use, like a booking page or a tracker. The project's own page says a booking tool takes weeks; a spreadsheet engine is far bigger.

checklist.title: Run them in order
checklist.detail: Recon, architect, design, build, backend, test, diff, entrepreneur, brand, launch, deploy. Each one reads what the last one wrote.

checklist.title: Rename it before anyone sees it
checklist.detail: Run /replica-brand for a new name, colours and logo. Nothing of the original app should be left.

safety: **It copies what an app does, never what it owns.** No code, logo, name, wording or content from the original. Give yours a new name before anyone else sees it.
**A real app takes weeks, not minutes.** Small tools are quick; anything with accounts and payments is a proper project.
**Only study what you're allowed to read:** public pages and your own account. Check the app's terms first.
**If you plan to sell it, check the trademark and talk to a lawyer.** This isn't legal advice.
**We have not built a full app with it ourselves yet.** Everything here is from the project's own page.
